# Testing Strategy Checklist: Harness-Gardening Drift Guards

## Fixture Corpus Coverage

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec require a checked-in fixture corpus with small synthetic fresh/stale documents, structured data, and reduced historical drift patterns rather than depending on the live repo as the primary oracle? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013; Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK002 Is the fixture directory layout defined for `fresh`, `hard`, `warning`, `dedupe`, and `errors` cases with `fixture.json`, optional `repo/` mini-tree, and expected report fields? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications; Data Model §Fixture Case]
- [x] CHK003 Are fresh cases required for every supported drift class so false-positive behavior is objectively testable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014; Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are hard, warning, dedupe, and error fixture classes required to cover every supported policy branch that can change CI outcome or recommendation shape? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010; Spec §FR-011; Spec §FR-021; Quickstart §Validate Fixture Behavior]
